materialization.note: Established by TWO independent statements in the source, 2026-09-20. The breadcrumb on both captured full item records reads 'Home > 1. Headquarters > Publications', and the handbook's record additionally carries an explicit 'Collections: Publications' block. One reading of one page would have been weaker evidence than this is. THE COLLECTION'S OWN UUID IS NOT IN EITHER CAPTURE -- only its name and its place in the hierarchy are -- and iris.who.int is egress-blocked from this environment, so the node is keyed by its PATH exactly as `collection/wpro-information-products` is, and for the same stated reason: inventing a UUID to fill the slot produces an identifier that resolves to nothing while looking authoritative. The collection's item count is likewise UNKNOWN; neither capture states one, and it is not interpolated.
